effect_description_eng:
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, if a card with [Lucemon] in its name is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, by trashing both players' top security cards, it doesn't leave.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] Your opponent may trash their top security card. If this effect didn't trash, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.) and delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 or higher w/[Lucemon] in name: Cost 3
